outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 762 preterm breech deliveries at 32 + 0-36 + 6 gestational weeks in Finland between 2004-2017
finding: Vaginal breech labor at 32 + 0-36 + 6 weeks of gestation was associated with increased risk of 5-minute Apgar scores below seven but decreased risk of neonatal antibiotic therapy, NICU admission, and respiratory distress syndrome compared to non-urgent cesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech labor at 32 + 0-36 + 6 gestational weeks does not increase severe neonatal short-term morbidity or mortality compared to cesarean section.
